initial_20_reasons.description: Jaw movement is driven by audio amplitude (RMS) rather than actual phonemes/visemes, causing a 'nutcracker' effect.
Motion starts exactly when audio starts. Humans move, inhale, or shift posture 100-200ms before vocalizing.
Procedural motions rely on Math.sin(), creating mathematically perfect, predictable, and robotic loops.
Lack of micro-saccadic eye movements. The gaze is locked and static, triggering the uncanny valley.
Blinking is either random or non-existent. Humans blink at the end of sentences or during cognitive shifts.
Head motions (nod/tilt) are isolated. Real human head movement naturally couples with the neck, shoulders, and upper spine.
The avatar maintains unbroken eye contact while 'thinking'. Humans naturally look up or away when retrieving information.
Procedural motions apply equally to both sides of the face/body. Human expressions and motions are inherently asymmetrical.
During sequence pauses, the mask drops to a near-zero floor, killing micro-fidgets and making the avatar look frozen.
The breathing primitive runs independently of speech. Humans alter or hold their breath while speaking.
Using ffmpeg asetrate to fake a female voice introduces metallic, robotic acoustic artifacts that break immersion.
Even with smoothstep, the attack/decay of gestures lacks the physical 'weight' and momentum of real muscles.
Aggressive spring smoothing (lambda) kills high-frequency micro-expressions, making the face look numb or sluggish.
When interrupted (Barge-in), the avatar stops abruptly without a natural 'startle' or 'listening' transition.
The motion sequencer picks from a small pool of variants randomly, leading to recognizable patterns over a 5-minute session.
Absence of biological audio-visual cues between long sentences (e.g., swallowing, taking a deep breath).
Emotions dictate the 'stance' (Persona), but do not dynamically alter the tension or speed of the procedural primitives in real-time.
Blending base and head layers on the neck bone causes micro-jitter when amplitudes clash, breaking the illusion of a solid spine.
The avatar does not react to the user's cursor, camera, or UI interactions, feeling disconnected from the environment.
Even with unified energy, the avatar lacks 'fatigue' or 'relaxation' arcs over a long session, maintaining an unnatural constant readiness.

self_critique.analysis: Many of the 20 reasons are symptoms of the same underlying architectural gaps. For example, 'Perfect Sine Waves', 'Static Pauses', and 'Linear Motion Envelopes' all stem from a lack of Organic Noise (Perlin/Simplex). 'RMS-Based Lip Sync' and 'Lack of Swallowing' are both Phoneme/Audio-sync issues. To provide a highly actionable, engineering-focused list, I must consolidate these into the 10 absolute root causes that separate a procedural puppet from a digital human.
self_critique.consolidation_strategy: Merge symptoms into core systems: 1. Viseme Engine, 2. Ocular Engine, 3. Temporal Anticipation, 4. Organic Noise, 5. Kinematic Coupling, 6. Cognitive State Mapping, 7. Asymmetry, 8. Acoustic Realism, 9. Respiratory Sync, 10. Physics/Weight.

final_10_critical_reasons.fix_required: Replace audio amplitude jaw-flapping with a true Phoneme-to-Viseme mapper (extracting phoneme timings from Piper/XTTS) to trigger specific blendshapes (A, E, I, O, U, M/P/B).

final_10_critical_reasons.root_cause: Absence of Saccades and Semantic Blinking
final_10_critical_reasons.fix_required: Implement a Gaze Controller that injects micro-saccades (rapid, tiny eye darts) and forces blinks at punctuation marks and cognitive shifts.
Delay audio playback by 150-200ms while allowing the Motion Sequencer to start immediately. The body must move *before* the voice is heard.
Inject 1D Simplex/Perlin noise into all procedural primitives (sway, nod, tilt) to break mathematical symmetry and introduce organic drift.
Propagate head rotations down the kinematic chain. A 10-degree head pitch must induce a 2-degree neck pitch and a 0.5-degree spine/chest pitch.
When `intent === 'thinking'`, the avatar must break eye contact (look up/left or down/right) to simulate memory retrieval, returning gaze on `explaining`.
Asetrate/aresample pitch shifting destroys vocal formants. Must upgrade to a native female TTS model (XTTSv2 or native Piper female) to restore biological resonance.
Breathing primitive must sync with speech. Inhale sharply before a long sentence, hold/shallow breathe during speech, and exhale on pauses.

final_10_critical_reasons.root_cause: Lack of Muscular Weight and Momentum
final_10_critical_reasons.fix_required: Motion envelopes need mass-spring-damper physics (overshoot and settle) rather than simple smoothstep, simulating the weight of the skull.
Apply a slight, randomized asymmetry multiplier to facial blendshapes (e.g., left smile slightly higher than right) to break the uncanny CGI perfection.
